title: Party Stash
description: True move semantics for the shared party stash: dragging an item between a dnd5e Group actor and one of its members moves it instead of copying it, when you own both sides. The system's own drop pipeline does the work — the source is only deleted after the copy lands, consumable stacks merge, container contents come along — and Ctrl-drag still forces a plain copy. All other drags (PC to PC, NPC looting, compendium drops) keep stock behavior. Coin, which can't be dragged, gets Deposit and Withdraw buttons on the group's currency row: a small dialog moves it denomination by denomination, capped at what the source is holding, and the purse row is read-only for players so the dialog is the one way coin moves. Every transfer in or out of the stash — items and coin — posts a receipt, an audit trail of who moved what: broadcast to the whole table, or whispered to the transfer's participants and the DMs, your choice.
